variants.prompt: Astrid reclines on a fur-lined throne in a lavish tent, her intricately embroidered choli top and lehnga skirt a sensual nod to Indian harem inspiration. She props one hand behind her head, her other hand resting on her thigh as she gazes at the camera with a sultry, inviting expression. The soft, warm lighting and the plush textures of the surroundings create an intimate, sensual atmosphere, while the shallow depth of field draws attention to her alluring figure.
